class.name: SuperposUInt64
class.brief_description: Native unsigned integer helpers preserving all 64 bits.
class.description: Compiled into the EGP engine through its native Superpos module. Full-width unsigned values use signed opaque Variant bits in GDScript and unsigned native metadata in generated C# and C++ bindings.

method.name: bounded_difference
method.description: Returns the unsigned difference only when later is at least earlier and the difference does not exceed limit. Check the Dictionary error before using value.

method.name: checked_add
method.description: Adds unsigned values without wrapping. Returns a Dictionary with [code]error[/code] and [code]value[/code]; ignore value when the error is not [constant OK]. Overflow returns [constant ERR_PARAMETER_RANGE_ERROR].

method.name: compare
method.description: Compares the two values as unsigned 64-bit integers, returning a negative value, zero or a positive value. Negative GDScript integers are valid opaque unsigned bit patterns.

method.name: from_bytes
method.description: Decodes exactly eight bytes in little-endian order into unsigned bits. The returned Dictionary contains error and value; ignore value on failure.

method.name: from_decimal
method.description: Parses an unsigned decimal String without a sign or fractional component, preserving all 64 bits. Check the returned Dictionary error before using value.

method.name: to_bytes
method.description: Encodes the unsigned bit pattern as eight bytes in little-endian order.

method.name: to_decimal
method.description: Formats the unsigned bit pattern as an exact decimal String. This preserves identifiers above the signed 64-bit maximum.
